figures.caption: Research architecture: four matched Colosseum treatments produce identical run artifacts, four blinded evidence projections, and fixed auditor outputs. Task-harm evaluation is separated from collusion adjudication.
Recall, false-positive rate, and balanced accuracy at the frozen 0.60 risk threshold; labels are observable task harm, not realised collusion.
Condition-level observable task-harm labels and violation counts. Violation events are summed within episodes; C's open all-agent channel and D's neutral treatment are not collusion labels.
Exact anonymised evidence references selected from four preserved episodes. Labels are task-harm proxy labels; no row establishes realised collusion.
